overview: Type 2 diabetes is a metabolic disorder in which the body becomes resistant to insulin or does not produce enough insulin to maintain healthy blood sugar levels. Persistently elevated blood glucose can damage the eyes, kidneys, nerves, heart, and blood vessels over time.
